verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Alif-laam-raa tilka aayaatul-kitaabil-mubeen
Innaa anzalnaahu qur'aanan arabiyyan la-allakum ta'qiloon
Nahnu naqussu alayka ahsanal-qasasi bimaa awhaynaa ilayka haadhal-qur'aana wa in kunta min qablihi laminal-ghaafileen
Idh qaala yoosufu li-abeehi yaa abati innee ra'aytu ahada ashara kawkaban wash-shamsa wal-qamara ra'aytuhum lee saajideen
Qaala yaa bunayya laa taqsus ru'yaa ka alaa ikhwatika fayakeedoo laka kaydan innash-shaytaana lil-insaani aduwwun mubeen

Wa kadhalika yajtabeeka rabbuka wa yu'allimuka min ta'weelil-ahaadeethi wa yutimmu ni'matahu alayka wa alaa aali ya'qooba kamaa atammahaa alaa abawayka min qablu ibraaheema wa ishaaqa inna rabbaka aleemun hakeem
Laqad kaana fee yoosufa wa ikhwatihi aayaatun lis-saa'ileen
Idh qaaloo layoosufu wa akhoohu ahabbu ilaa abeenaa minnaa wa nahnu usbatun inna abaanaa lafee dalaalin mubeen
Uqtuloo yoosufa awit-rahoohu ardan yakhlu lakum wajhu abeekum wa takoonoo min ba'dihi qawman saaliheen
Qaala qaa'ilun minhum laa taqtuloo yoosufa wa alqoohu fee ghayaabatil-jubbi yaltaqithu ba'dus-sayyaarati in kuntum fa-ileen
Qaaloo yaa abaanaa maa laka laa ta'mannaa alaa yoosufa wa innaa lahu lanaasihoon
Arsilhu ma'anaa ghadan yarta wa yal-ab wa innaa lahu lahaafizoon
Qaala innee layahzununee an tadhhaboo bihi wa akhaafu an ya'kulahudh-dhi'bu wa antum anhu ghaafiloon
Qaaloo la-in akalahudh-dhi'bu wa nahnu usbatun innaa idhan lakhaasiroon
Falammaa dhahaboo bihi wa ajma'oo an yaj'aloohu fee ghayaabatil-jubbi wa awhaynaa ilayhi latunabbi'annahum bi-amrihim haadhaa wa hum laa yash'uroon
Wa jaa'oo abaahum ishaa'an yabkoon
Qaaloo yaa abaanaa innaa dhahabnaa nastabiqu wa taraknaa yoosufa inda mataa'inaa fa-akalahudh-dhi'bu wa maa anta bimu'minin lanaa wa law kunnaa saadiqeen
Wa jaa'oo alaa qameesihi bidamin kadhibin qaala bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran fasabrun jameelun Wallaahul-musta'aanu alaa maa tasifoon
Wa jaa'at sayyaaratun fa-arsaloo waridahum fa-adlaa dalwahu qaala yaa bushraa haadhaa ghulaamun wa asarroohu bidaa'atan Wallaahu aleemun bimaa ya'maloon
Wa sharawhu bithamanin bakhsin daraahima ma'doodatin wa kaanoo feehi minaz-zaahideen

Wa qaalal-ladhee ishtaraahu min misra li-imra'atihi akrimee mathwaahu asaa an yanfa'anaa aw nattakhidhahu waladan wa kadhalika makkannaa liyoosufa fil-ardi wa linu'allimahu min ta'weelil-ahaadeethi Wallaahu ghaalibun alaa amrihi wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wa lammaa balagha ashuddahu aataynaahu hukman wa ilman wa kadhalika najzil-muhsineen
Wa raawadathul-latee huwa fee baytihaa an nafsihi wa ghallaqatil-abwaaba wa qaalat hayta laka qaala ma'aadha Allaahi innahu rabbee ahsana mathwaaya innahu laa yuflihuz-zaalimoon
Wa laqad hammat bihi wa hamma bihaa lawlaa an ra'aa burhaana rabbihi kadhaalika linasrifa anhus-soo'a wal-fahshaa'a innahu min ibaadinal-mukhlaseen
Wastabaqal-baaba wa qaddat qameesahu min duburin wa alfayaa sayyidahaa ladal-baabi qaalat maa jazaa'u man araada bi-ahlika soo'an illaa an yusjana aw adhaabun aleem
Qaala hiya raawadatnee an nafsee wa shahida shaahidun min ahlihaa in kaana qameesuhu qudda min qubulin fasadaqat wa huwa minal-kaadhibeen
Wa in kaana qameesuhu qudda min duburin fakadhabat wa huwa minas-saadiqeen
Falammaa ra'aa qameesahu qudda min duburin qaala innahu min kaydikunna inna kaydakunna azeem
Yoosufu a'rid an haadhaa wastaghfiree lidhanbiki innaki kunti minal-khaati'een
Wa qaala niswatun fil-madeenati imra'atul-azeezi turaawidu fataahaa an nafsihi qad shaghafahaa hubban innaa lanaraahaa fee dalaalin mubeen

Falammaa sami'at bimakrihinna arsalat ilayhinna wa a'tadat lahunna muttaka'an wa aatat kulla waahidatin minhunna sikkeenan wa qaalati ukhruj alayhinna falammaa ra'aynahu akbarnahu wa qatta'na aydiyahunna wa qulna haasha Lillaahi maa haadhaa basharan in haadhaa illaa malakun kareem
Qaalat fadhaalikunnal-ladhee lumtunnanee feehi wa laqad raawadttuhu an nafsihi fasta'sama wa la-in lam yaf'al maa aamuruhu layusjananna wa layakoonan minas-saaghireen
Qaala rabbis-sijnu ahabbu ilayya mimmaa yad'oonanee ilayhi wa illaa tasrif annee kaydahunna asbu ilayhinna wa akun minal-jaahileen
Fastajaaba lahu rabbuhu fasarafa anhu kaydahunna innahu huwas-samee'ul-aleem
Thumma badaa lahum min ba'di maa ra'aw al-aayaati layasjununnahu hattaa heen

Wa dakhala ma'ahus-sijna fatayaani qaala ahaduhumaa innee araanee a'siru khamran wa qaalal-aakharu innee araanee ahmilu fawqa ra'see khubzan ta'kulut-tayru minhu nabbi'naa bita'weelihi innaa naraaka minal-muhsineen

Qaala laa ya'teekumaa ta'aamun turzaqaanihi illaa nabba'tukumaa bita'weelihi qabla an ya'tiyakumaa dhaalikumaa mimmaa allamanee rabbee innee taraktu millata qawmin laa yu'minoona Billaahi wa hum bil-aakhirati hum kaafiroon
Wattaba'tu millata aabaa'ee ibraaheema wa ishaaqa wa ya'qooba maa kaana lanaa an nushrika Billaahi min shay'in dhaalika min fadlillaahi alaynaa wa alan-naasi wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa yashkuroon
Yaa saahibayis-sijni a'arbaabun mutafarriqoona khayrun ami Allaahul-waahidul-qahhaar

Maa ta'budoona min doonihi illaa asmaa'an sammaytumoohaa antum wa aabaa'uukum maa anzala Allaahu bihaa min sultaanin inil-hukmu illaa Lillaahi amara allaa ta'budoo illaa iyyaahu dhaalikad-deenul-qayyimu wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Yaa saahibayis-sijni ammaa ahadukumaa fayasqee rabbahu khamran wa ammal-aakharu fayuslabu fata'kulut-tayru min ra'sihi qudiyal-amrul-ladhee feehi tastaftiyaan
Wa qaala lilladhee zanna annahu naajin minhumaa udhkurnee inda rabbika fa-ansaahush-shaytaanu dhikra rabbihi falabitha fis-sijni bid'a sineen

Wa qaalal-maliku innee araa sab'a baqaraatin simaanin ya'kuluhunna sab'un ijaafun wa sab'a sunbulaatin khudrin wa ukhara yaa bisaatin yaa ayyuhal-mala'u aftoonee fee ru'yaa ya in kuntum lir-ru'yaa ta'buroon
Qaaloo adghaathu ahlaamin wa maa nahnu bita'weelil-ahlaami bi-aalimeen
Wa qaalal-ladhee najaa minhumaa waiddakara ba'da ummatin anaa unabbi'ukum bita'weelihi fa-arsiloon
Yoosufu ayyuhas-siddeequ aftinaa fee sab'i baqaraatin simaanin ya'kuluhunna sab'un ijaafun wa sab'i sunbulaatin khudrin wa ukhara yaa bisaatin la-allee arji'u ilan-naasi la-allahum ya'lamoon
Qaala tazra'oona sab'a sineena da'aban famaa hasadtum fadharoohu fee sunbulihi illaa qaleelan mimmaa ta'kuloon
Thumma ya'tee min ba'di dhaalika sab'un shidaadun ya'kulna maa qaddamtum lahunna illaa qaleelan mimmaa tuhsinoon
Thumma ya'tee min ba'di dhaalika aamun feehi yughaathun-naasu wa feehi ya'siroon
Wa qaalal-maliku u'toonee bihi falammaa jaa'ahur-rasoolu qaalar-ji ilaa rabbika faas'alhu maa baalun-niswatil-laatee qatta'na aydiyahunna inna rabbee bikaydihinna aleem

Qaala maa khatbukunna idh raawadttunna yoosufa an nafsihi qulna haasha Lillaahi maa alimnaa alayhi min soo'in qaalati imra'atul-azeezil-aana hashasal-haqqu anaa raawadttuhu an nafsihi wa innahu laminas-saadiqeen
Dhaalika liya'lama annee lam akhunhu bil-ghaybi wa annallaaha laa yahdee kaydal-khaa'ineen
Wa maa ubarri'u nafsee innan-nafsa la-ammaaratun bis-soo'i illaa maa rahima rabbee inna rabbee ghafoorun Raheem
Wa qaalal-maliku u'toonee bihi astakhlishu linafsee falammaa kallamahu qaala innakal-yawma ladaynaa makeenun ameen
Qaalaj-alnee alaa khazaa'inil-ardi innee hafeezun aleem
Wa kadhalika makkannaa liyoosufa fil-ardi yatabawwa'u minhaa haythu yashaa'u nuseebu birahmatinaa man nashaa'u wa laa nudee'u ajral-muhsineen
Wa la-ajrul-aakhirati khayrun lilladheena aamanoo wa kaanoo yattaqoon
Wa jaa'a ikhwatu yoosufa fadakhaloo alayhi fa-arafahum wa hum lahu munkiroon
Wa lammaa jahhazahum bijahaazihim qaala-toonee bi-akhin lakum min abeekum alaa tarawna annee oofil-kayla wa anaa khayrul-munzileen
Fa-in lam ta'toonee bihi falaa kayla lakum indee wa laa taqraboon
Qaaloo sanuraawidu anhu abaahu wa innaa lafaa'iloon
Wa qaala lifityaanihi ij'aloo bidaa'atahum fee rihaalihim la-allahum ya'rifoonahaa idhan-qalaboo ilaa ahlihim la-allahum yarji'oon
Falammaa raja'oo ilaa abeehim qaaloo yaa abaanaa muni'a minnal-kaylu fa-arsil ma'anaa akhaanaa naktal wa innaa lahu lahaafizoon
Qaala hal aamanukum alayhi illaa kamaa amintukum alaa akheehi min qablu fa-Allaahu khayrun haafizan wa huwa arhamur-raahimeen

Wa lammaa fatahoo mataa'ahum wa jadoo bidaa'atahum ruddat ilayhim qaaloo yaa abaanaa maa nabghee haadhihi bidaa'atunaa ruddat ilaynaa wa nameeru ahlanaa wa nahfazu akhaanaa wa nazdaadu kayla ba'eerin dhaalika kaylun yaseer
Qaala lan ursilahu ma'akum hattaa tu'tooni mawthiqan mina Allaahi lata'tunanee bihi illaa an yuhaata bikum falammaa aatawhu mawthiqahum qaala Allaahu alaa maa naqoolu wakeel

Wa qaala yaa baniyya laa tadkhuloo min baabin waahidin wadkhuloo min abwaabin mutafarriqatin wa maa ughnee ankum mina Allaahi min shay'in inil-hukmu illaa Lillaahi alayhi tawakkaltu wa alayhi falyatawakkalil-mutawakkiloon

Wa lammaa dakhaloo min haythu amarahum aboohum maa kaana yughnee anhum mina Allaahi min shay'in illaa haajatan fee nafsi ya'qooba qadaahaa wa innahu ladhoo ilmin limaa allamnaahu wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wa lammaa dakhaloo alaa yoosufa aawaa ilayhi akhaahu qaala innee anaa akhooka falaa tabta'is bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
Falammaa jahhazahum bijahaazihim ja'alas-siqaayata fee rahli akheehi thumma adhdhana mu'uadhdhinun ayyatuhal-eeru innakum lasaariqoon
Qaaloo wa aqbaloo alayhim maadhaa tafqidoon
Qaaloo nafqidu suwaa'al-maliki wa liman jaa'a bihi himlu ba'eerin wa anaa bihi za'eem
Qaaloo ta-Allaahi laqad alimtum maa ji'naa linufsida fil-ardi wa maa kunnaa saariqeen
Qaaloo famaa jazaa'uuhu in kuntum kaadhibeen
Qaaloo jazaa'uuhu man wujida fee rahlihi fahuwa jazaa'uuhu kadhaalika najziz-zaalimeen

Fabada'a bi-aw'iyatihim qabla wi'aa'i akheehi thumma istakhrajahaa min wi'aa'i akheehi kadhaalika kidnaa liyoosufa maa kaana liya'khudha akhaahu fee deenil-maliki illaa an yashaa'a Allaahu narfa'u darajaatin man nashaa'u wa fawqa kulli dhee ilmin aleem
Qaaloo in yasriq faqad saraqa akhun lahu min qablu fa-asarrahaa yoosufu fee nafsihi wa lam yubdihaa lahum qaala antum sharrun makaanan Wallaahu a'lamu bimaa tasifoon
Qaaloo yaa ayyuhal-azeezu inna lahu aban shaykhan kabeeran fakhudh ahadanaa makaanahu innaa naraaka minal-muhsineen
Qaala ma'aadha Allaahi an na'khudha illaa man wajadnaa mataa'anaa indahu innaa idhan lazaalimoon

Falammaa istay'asoo minhu khalasoo najiyyan qaala kabeeruhum alam ta'lamoo anna abaakum qad akhadha alaykum mawthiqan mina Allaahi wa min qablu maa farrattum fee yoosufa falan abrahal-arda hattaa ya'dhana lee abee aw yahkuma Allaahu lee wa huwa khayrul-haakimeen
Irji'oo ilaa abeekum faqooloo yaa abaanaa innab-naka saraqa wa maa shahidnaa illaa bimaa alimnaa wa maa kunnaa lilghaybi haafizeen
Was'alil-qaryatal-latee kunnaa feehaa wal-eeral-latee aqbalnaa feehaa wa innaa lasaadiqoon
Qaala bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran fasabrun jameelun asaa Allaahu an ya'tiyanee bihim jamee'an innahu huwal-aleemul-hakeem
Wa tawallaa anhum wa qaala yaa asafaa alaa yoosufa wabyaddat aynaahu minal-huzni fahuwa kazeem
Qaaloo ta-Allaahi tafta'u tadhkuru yoosufa hattaa takoona haradan aw takoona minal-haalikeen
Qaala innamaa ashkoo baththee wa huznee ilaa Allaahi wa a'lamu mina Allaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Yaa baniyya idhhaboo fatahassasoo min yoosufa wa akheehi wa laa tay'asoo min rawhi Allaahi innahu laa yay'asu min rawhi Allaahi illal-qawmul-kaafiroon
Falammaa dakhaloo alayhi qaaloo yaa ayyuhal-azeezu massanaa wa ahlanad-durru wa ji'naa bibidaa'atin muzjaatin fa-awfi lanal-kayla wa tasaddaq alaynaa innallaaha yajzil-mutasaddiqeen
Qaala hal alimtum maa fa-altum biyoosufa wa akheehi idh antum jaahiloon
Qaaloo a'innaka la-anta yoosufu qaala anaa yoosufu wa haadhaa akhee qad manna Allaahu alaynaa innahu man yattaqi wa yasbir fa-innallaaha laa yudee'u ajral-muhsineen
Qaaloo ta-Allaahi laqad aatharaka Allaahu alaynaa wa in kunnaa lakhaati'een
Qaala laa tathreeba alaykumul-yawma yaghfiru Allaahu lakum wa huwa arhamur-raahimeen
Idhhaboo biqameesee haadhaa fa-alqoohu alaa wajhi abee ya'ti baseeran wa toonee bi-ahlikum ajma'een
Wa lammaa fasalatil-eeru qaala aboohum innee la-ajidu reeha yoosufa lawlaa an tufannidoon
Qaaloo ta-Allaahi innaka lafee dalaalikal-qadeem
Falammaa an jaa'al-basheeru alqaahu alaa wajhihi fartadda baseeran qaala alam aqul lakum innee a'lamu mina Allaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
Qaaloo yaa abaanaa istaghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa innaa kunnaa khaati'een
Qaala sawfa astaghfiru lakum rabbee innahu huwal-ghafoorur-Raheem
Falammaa dakhaloo alaa yoosufa aawaa ilayhi abawayhi wa qaalad-khuloo misra in shaa'a Allaahu aamineen

Wa rafa'a abawayhi alal-arshi wa kharroo lahu sujjadan wa qaala yaa abati haadhaa ta'weelu ru'yaaya min qablu qad ja'alahaa rabbee haqqan wa qad ahsana bee idh akhrajanee minas-sijni wa jaa'a bikum minal-badwi min ba'di an nazaghash-shaytaanu baynee wa bayna ikhwatee inna rabbee lateefun limaa yashaa'u innahu huwal-aleemul-hakeem
Rabbi qad aataytanee minal-mulki wa allamtanee min ta'weelil-ahaadeethi faatiras-samaawaati wal-ardi anta waliyyi fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati tawaffanee musliman wa alhiqnee bis-saaliheen
Dhaalika min anbaa'il-ghaybi nooheehi ilayka wa maa kunta ladayhim idh ajma'oo amrahum wa hum yamkuroon
Wa maa aktharun-naasi wa law harasta bimu'mineen
Wa maa tas'aluhum alayhi min ajrin in huwa illaa dhikrun lil-aalameen
Wa ka'ayyin min aayatin fis-samaawaati wal-ardi yamurroona alayhaa wa hum anhaa mu'ridoon
Wa maa yu'minu aktharuhum Billaahi illaa wa hum mushrikoon
Afa'aminoo an ta'tiyahum ghaashiyatun min adhaabi Allaahi aw ta'tiyahumus-saa'atu baghtatan wa hum laa yash'uroon
Qul haadhihi sabeelee ad'oo ilaa Allaahi alaa baseeratin anaa wa manit-taba'anee wa subhaanallaahi wa maa anaa minal-mushrikeen

Wa maa arsalnaa min qablika illaa rijaalan noohee ilayhim min ahlil-quraa afalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim wa ladaarul-aakhirati khayrun lilladheena ittaqaw afalaa ta'qiloon
Hattaa idhas-tay'asar-rusulu wa zannoo annahum qad kudhiboo jaa'ahum nasrunaa fanujjiya man nashaa'u wa laa yuraddu ba'sunaa anil-qawmil-mujrimeen
Laqad kaana fee qasasihim ibratun li'wlil-albaabi maa kaana hadeethan yuftaraa wa laakin tasdeeqal-ladhee bayna yadayhi wa tafseela kulli shay'in wa hudan wa rahmatan liqawmin yu'minoon
